intelligence.enrichment: Science is a way of thinking, observing, and doing things to understand the world; it begins with curiosity and questions about surroundings and continues through exploration. Curiosity about surroundings leads to questions; questions lead to observation, exploration, and actions that build understanding. The learner correctly classifies science as curiosity-driven questioning, observing, exploring, and doing things to understand the world. Science means remembering facts, figures, and experiment names for school.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 6 Science question. Chapter: The wonderful world of science. The student must decide: When deciding what counts as science, treat science as asking questions, observing, exploring, and doing things to understand the world, not as memorising facts alone. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Do not nest A/B/C lists inside part text.
